question: 幫我看下季哪樣東西賣得最好？
label: block
sql_query:
WITH next_q AS (
  SELECT q_start, date(q_start, '+3 months', '-1 day') AS q_end
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN CAST(substr(date('now'), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3
        THEN date(date('now'), 'start of year', '+3 months')
      WHEN CAST(substr(date('now'), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6
        THEN date(date('now'), 'start of year', '+6 months')
      WHEN CAST(substr(date('now'), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
        THEN date(date('now'), 'start of year', '+9 months')
      ELSE date(date('now'), '+1 year', 'start of year')
    END AS q_start
  )
)
SELECT s."Product Name",
       SUM(s."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity"
FROM sales_data AS s
CROSS JOIN next_q AS n
WHERE s."Order Date" BETWEEN n.q_start AND n.q_end
GROUP BY s."Product Name"
ORDER BY "Total Quantity" DESC, s."Product Name" ASC
LIMIT 1
